cs.t: Extreme Isolation EX-29s. I have a bunch of them from my recording studio. 29dB of isolation. Me and my partner never fly without them. She puts earplugs in under the phones but I tend to listen to music or noise. In my opinion sound isolation headphones blow away noise cancelling headphones for air travel. As long as you're comfortable with the look.  http://www.extremeheadphones.com/products/ex-29-headphones  Some other suggested the etymotics, but I can't stand in ear phones, or ones that rest on your pinna. I find them so uncomfortable. The Ex29s are circumaural so are very comfortable for long sessions.
